title: Staff Software Engineer
descriptionText: Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry’s digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity. Xometry is looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our Core Platform team. This role is a strategic technical leadership position focused on the architectural evolution of our flagship enterprise partnership. While our current plug-ins function as external add-ons, you will be responsible for re-architecting Xometry’s core application services to live natively within our partner's digital ecosystem. You will shape the technical direction of multiple products, establishing the engineering patterns that allow Xometry’s AI—trained on millions of parts—to operate directly on our partner's native 3D geometry. Your goal is to move the architectural framework toward a "target state" where users experience zero-latency DFM feedback and one-click procurement without ever leaving their primary enterprise design environment. This role requires a hybrid schedule (3 days a week) at our North Bethesda, MD or Waltham, MA office location. How You'll Contribute Software Development and Technical Craft: You will design high-performance solutions that extend beyond a single org, establishing the organizational standards for how Xometry-AI is embedded into external PLM environments. You will advance our architectural framework to ensure it is extensible, scalable, and adheres to strict enterprise SLIs/SLOs. AI Fluency: You will lead the effort to integrate production ML pipelines into the application layer, ensuring the "science fiction speed" promised in our vision is realized through optimized model serving and real-time geometry analysis. In addition, you’ll champion AI-assisted development practices across the team, actively mentoring engineers on effective use of AI tools to accelerate delivery, improve code quality, and reduce toil. Problem Solving and Decision Making: You will solve significant and unique challenges regarding data gravity and security. You'll create formal networks between our partner's and Xometry’s engineering groups to develop new ways of conducting operations—specifically regarding "ring-fenced" data governance where part files remain securely within the partner's network infrastructure. Scope and Impact: You are responsible for establishing the strategic direction and leading the execution of this core integration. You will be a technical and business role model, ensuring that the integration of DFM (Manufacturability) and IQE (Pricing) AI engines creates a distinct, defensible edge for the partnership. Collaboration and Communication: You will facilitate technical discourse across the entire Xometry organization, leading to durable, well-documented decisions. As a primary point of contact for senior leadership, you will guide risk/reward conversations and champion cross-functional development across our marketplace and data science teams. Operational Excellence: You will define the reliability and security standards for our enterprise-grade deployments, whether partner-hosted or Xometry-hosted, ensuring seamless multi-tenant management. What You'll Bring to Xometry Experience: 12+ years of professional software development experience, with a history of scaling complex platforms. Deep Technical Expertise: Expert-level mastery of Python, AWS infrastructure, and modern frontend frameworks (React/NextJS) used for complex enterprise applications. Systems Architect: Proven experience shaping the technical direction of multiple teams and establishing engineering patterns as organizational standards. Strategic Roadmap Execution: A track record of securing endorsement for 6-12 month initiatives and driving them to successful production deployment. Communication Excellence: The ability to influence senior leadership and external partners on technical strategy and long-term technology investments. Education: Bachelor’s in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience. You Would Be A Great Fit With Platform Experience: Background in building "Software as a Service" (SaaS) platforms or complex B2B integration hubs. Industrial Tech Background: Experience with manufacturing, logistics, or CAD/PLM software ecosystems. Security & Governance: Deep understanding of enterprise data controls, dedicated tenants, and SOC2/ISO compliance within a cloud environment. Distributed Systems: Experience architecting large-scale ML platforms or high-frequency marketplace engines. act as the primary technical DRI for cross-team, multi-system, and cost-impacting changes - Establish and enforce engineering standards and production readiness criteria across all DPE-owned systems - testing requirements, CI/CD patterns, observability-as-code, logging standards, data contracts, Schema Registry governance, and what 'production-ready' means for emerging streaming and CDC capabilities - Own data quality and observability architecture - dbt anomaly detection frameworks, schema validation, data drift alerting, and the platform standards that ensure consumers can trust the data they build on - Define the technical strategy for self-service analytics: what platform capabilities enable Analytics Engineering to work independently, what guardrails prevent downstream breakage, and how DPE reduces its bottleneck over time - Own evaluation, onboarding, and ongoing governance of DPE-managed tooling - Fivetran, Confluent, and equivalent platforms, including contract management, cost tracking, and deprecation decisions - Own data sharing and egress patterns - access provisioning, cross-team data contracts, reverse ETL (Hightouch), and governed consumption paths for internal and external consumers - Drive cost governance for platform infrastructure - BigQuery slot reservations, query optimization, partition strategies, orchestration rightsizing, and cloud spend accountability across the full DPE stack - Lead incident response for platform-level P1/P2 incidents: act as technical escalation point, facilitate blameless RCAs, and drive systemic fixes that prevent recurrence - Produce exemplary technical artifacts - architecture decision records, solution design docs, RFCs - that create alignment and become the team's reference standard - Mentor and elevate Staff and Senior Data Engineers; raise the technical ceiling through design reviews, code reviews, and hands-on pairing - Partner cross-functionally with ML/Data Science, legal/security/compliance, and DevOps to deliver platform capabilities that are ML-ready, compliant with HIPAA/GDPR, and hardened at the infrastructure layer - Contribute hands-on to critical path work YOU HAVE: - 15+ years of professional experience designing, building, and owning data platform architecture at company scale - Demonstrated ability to define and align architectural vision with business goals across an entire engineering organization - Deep expertise in cloud-native data platforms across GCP primary (BigQuery, GCS, Dataflow); AWS operational familiarity required (EKS-based Airflow) - BigQuery strongly preferred; multi-cloud fluency is required, not a plus - Hands-on experience with the modern data stack: experience governing dbt at platform scale, Airflow/Astronomer, Kafka/Confluent, Databricks/Spark, Fivetran, and data sharing/activation platforms (Hightouch or equivalent) - Experience designing and operating event streaming pipelines at scale - including Schema Registry, data contracts, and consumer lag management - Proven track record establishing engineering standards across multiple teams and driving adoption without direct authority - Experience owning data quality frameworks - dbt testing, anomaly detection, schema validation, and data observability tooling - Experience with data governance and compliance frameworks in a regulated environment - HIPAA/PHI handling, data classification, access controls, audit logging, and GDPR - Experience leading incident response for data platform outages - blameless RCA, systemic root cause identification, and operational improvement - Infrastructure-as-code fluency - Terraform or equivalent; you treat infrastructure changes like software changes - Strong Python and SQL skills; comfortable writing, reviewing, and raising the bar on production-grade pipeline code - Clear written communication: you produce design docs and RFCs that build alignment, not confusion. Comfort operating in ambiguity - you define the path, you don't wait for it to be defined PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS: - Databricks, Unity Catalog, and Delta Lake in production at scale - Experience with CDC (Change Data Capture) patterns and Flink for real-time data processing - PySpark/SparkSQL for large-scale batch and streaming workloads - Experience driving a BigQuery → Databricks Lakehouse migration or equivalent cloud data warehouse migration - Experience with MLOps - partnering with ML engineers on model training pipelines, feature stores, and experimentation infrastructure - Go or Python service development for Kafka producers and consumers - Experience at a direct-to-consumer healthcare or telehealth company with HIPAA and GDPR obligations - Familiarity with SOX compliance controls in a data engineering context OUR BENEFITS (THERE ARE MORE BUT HERE ARE SOME HIGHLIGHTS): - Competitive salary & equity compensation for full-time roles - Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and quarterly mental health days - Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental & vision, and parental leave - Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP) - 401k benefits with employer matching contribution - Offsite team retreats We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. title: Facilities Tech II, Maintenance
descriptionText: Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about http://hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works http://hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals http://www.hims.com/careers-professionals. ABOUT THE ROLE: In this role as Facilities Technician II, Maintenance, you will provide mid-level support to the Operations, Engineering & Maintenance Department by applying predictive and preventive maintenance procedures for all critical production equipment in the warehouse like HVAC, Compressor, Forklifts etc. You will analyze, troubleshoot, and communicate maintenance problems/concerns in the following areas: electrical, mechanical, plumbing, air compression, and HVAC relating to the equipment in the warehouse. You will work with general supervision and will interact with a supervisor several times per week, perhaps daily, to receive guidance and feedback. Many non-routine activities will require a supervisor’s advance approval. You will report to the Director of Industrial Engineering. YOU WILL: - Equipment Maintenance – Assist with or perform independently corrective, preventive and planned maintenance activities on production-related equipment such as conveyance, shelving, racking etc., powered industrial trucks, and building equipment such as HVAC, Air compressors, water filtration as needed. - Building Maintenance – Perform painting, sheetrock repairs, and general tenant improvement work as needed. Perform minor repairs on doors, dock plates, and plumbing to resolve problems and ensure successful operation. Evaluate, repair and maintain plumbing, electrical and HVAC systems. - Facility Cleanliness / Safety – Ensure the primary work areas are organized, neat and clean both during and upon completion of maintenance related activities. Adhere to 5S principles. Identify and act immediately regarding any safety hazards, spills, etc., to avoid the risk of accidents. Use safe lifting techniques and operate power equipment in a safe manner. Abide by all stated regulations while performing work. Understands and complies with all hazardous energy policies and procedures including lock-out/tag-out. - Fabrication – Utilize materials and tools to assist with the creation of custom equipment to support the operation (i.e., wood, metal, etc.). - Record Keeping -- Perform necessary data entry (i.e., work order tracking/filing) and keep current tools and documents updated as necessary (i.e., Safety Data Sheets). Maintain records using appropriate software (i.e. Maintenance Connection) to ensure accountability of time, parts and repairs. - Identify facilities issues and develop an ongoing strategy to chart trends and take appropriate remedial action from a predictive maintenance approach. - Communicate to management all issues that could result in safety risks or those that might cause loss to Hims or its associates. - Work as directed in all areas of the Warehouse to maintain safety and health standards for the facility. - Perform calibration and testing procedures on equipment to ensure accurate operation and compliance with quality standards. - Respond promptly to equipment breakdowns, emergencies, and production interruptions to minimize downtime. - Work closely with production personnel to coordinate repairs and minimize disruptions to the manufacturing process. - Identify opportunities for process optimization, efficiency improvements, and cost savings related to equipment maintenance and operation. - Participate in cross-functional teams to implement improvement projects and contribute to the continuous improvement culture within the organization. - Stay updated with industry trends, technological advancements, and best practices related to general equipment maintenance. YOU HAVE: - Ability to safely lift and carry items weighing up to 50 pounds, either in conjunction with his or her regular responsibilities or those assigned in other areas as directed. - Proficiency using business computer systems and applications—specifically, Microsoft Word, Excel, and Project Management - Ability to troubleshoot problems with machinery without supervision or direction. - Demonstrated experience documenting predictive/preventive maintenance charts, technical data and other data; interpret data and providing relevant input for process improvement. - Ability to communicate effectively with others using spoken and written English (Bilingual in Spanish preferred) - Must be able to bend, stoop, reach overhead with arms and hands and climb ladders; must be able to climb stairs up to three flights and not be afraid of heights utilizing scissor or bucket lifts. - Experience working cooperatively and collaboratively with others; conducting working relationships in a manner acceptable to others and to the organization. - The learning capacity to receive and apply cross-functional training; willingness to assist other functions and work groups as needed so the department achieves or exceeds its overall business objectives. - 3+ years of industry experience in maintenance, facilities, or field with related skills. - Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot, maintain, and operate advance technical equipment in a related industry. - Have knowledge of and experience with PLC systems - Have knowledge of and experience with CMMS systems - Formal training or certification through an accredited institution in at least one of the following areas: electrical, mechanical, plumbing, air compression, PLC system or HVAC trades - 5+ years previous maintenance experience in a manufacturing facility or with equipment mentioned above. - 5+ years of electrical knowledge and electronic principles - Advanced degree/training in engineering, maintenance, or other related field - Advanced formal training in lean or six sigma - High school diploma or equivalent GED required. OUR BENEFITS (THERE ARE MORE BUT HERE ARE SOME HIGHLIGHTS): - Competitive pay & comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental & vision Conditions of Employment: - Physical exertion required. Including, but not limited to, walking up to 50% of the time, standing up to 100% of the time, squatting and bending up to 20% of the time and lifting up to 80% of the time for up to a twelve hour shift. Must be able to lift up to 50lbs. We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. title: Staff Software Engineer
descriptionText: Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry’s digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity. Xometry is looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our Core Platform team. This role is a strategic technical leadership position focused on the architectural evolution of our flagship enterprise partnership. While our current plug-ins function as external add-ons, you will be responsible for re-architecting Xometry’s core application services to live natively within our partner's digital ecosystem. You will shape the technical direction of multiple products, establishing the engineering patterns that allow Xometry’s AI—trained on millions of parts—to operate directly on our partner's native 3D geometry. Your goal is to move the architectural framework toward a "target state" where users experience zero-latency DFM feedback and one-click procurement without ever leaving their primary enterprise design environment. This role requires a hybrid schedule (3 days a week) at our North Bethesda, MD or Waltham, MA office location. How You'll Contribute Software Development and Technical Craft: You will design high-performance solutions that extend beyond a single org, establishing the organizational standards for how Xometry-AI is embedded into external PLM environments. You will advance our architectural framework to ensure it is extensible, scalable, and adheres to strict enterprise SLIs/SLOs. AI Fluency: You will lead the effort to integrate production ML pipelines into the application layer, ensuring the "science fiction speed" promised in our vision is realized through optimized model serving and real-time geometry analysis. In addition, you’ll champion AI-assisted development practices across the team, actively mentoring engineers on effective use of AI tools to accelerate delivery, improve code quality, and reduce toil. Problem Solving and Decision Making: You will solve significant and unique challenges regarding data gravity and security. You'll create formal networks between our partner's and Xometry’s engineering groups to develop new ways of conducting operations—specifically regarding "ring-fenced" data governance where part files remain securely within the partner's network infrastructure. Scope and Impact: You are responsible for establishing the strategic direction and leading the execution of this core integration. You will be a technical and business role model, ensuring that the integration of DFM (Manufacturability) and IQE (Pricing) AI engines creates a distinct, defensible edge for the partnership. Collaboration and Communication: You will facilitate technical discourse across the entire Xometry organization, leading to durable, well-documented decisions. As a primary point of contact for senior leadership, you will guide risk/reward conversations and champion cross-functional development across our marketplace and data science teams. Operational Excellence: You will define the reliability and security standards for our enterprise-grade deployments, whether partner-hosted or Xometry-hosted, ensuring seamless multi-tenant management. What You'll Bring to Xometry Experience: 12+ years of professional software development experience, with a history of scaling complex platforms. Deep Technical Expertise: Expert-level mastery of Python, AWS infrastructure, and modern frontend frameworks (React/NextJS) used for complex enterprise applications. Systems Architect: Proven experience shaping the technical direction of multiple teams and establishing engineering patterns as organizational standards. Strategic Roadmap Execution: A track record of securing endorsement for 6-12 month initiatives and driving them to successful production deployment. Communication Excellence: The ability to influence senior leadership and external partners on technical strategy and long-term technology investments. Education: Bachelor’s in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience. You Would Be A Great Fit With Platform Experience: Background in building "Software as a Service" (SaaS) platforms or complex B2B integration hubs. Industrial Tech Background: Experience with manufacturing, logistics, or CAD/PLM software ecosystems. Security & Governance: Deep understanding of enterprise data controls, dedicated tenants, and SOC2/ISO compliance within a cloud environment. Distributed Systems: Experience architecting large-scale ML platforms or high-frequency marketplace engines. title: Principal Partner Success Engineer
descriptionText: Yahoo Mail is the ultimate consumer inbox with hundreds of millions of users. It’s the best way to access your email and stay organized from a computer, phone or tablet. With its beautiful design and lightning fast speed, Yahoo Mail makes reading, organizing, and sending emails easier than ever. A Little About Us Yahoo Mail is building Data Products - externalizing our high-signal behavioral and engagement data as partner-ready APIs and data feeds. We are seeking a Partner Success Engineer to serve as the Directly Responsible Individual (DRI) for driving flawless, end-to-end partner integrations. This is not a transactional support role; it is an ownership position sitting at the intersection of engineering, data, and partnerships. You will ensure every API contract is met, every SLA is honored, and every enterprise partner maximizes value from Yahoo Mail’s data platform. You will build the external face of our data platform from the ground up, collaborating within a high-velocity micro-squad that operates with startup-level autonomy inside one of the world's most data-rich consumer platforms. A Lot About You You are a seasoned engineering professional who thrives at the intersection of complex distributed systems and partner relationships. You bring a strong ownership mindset - you do not wait for tickets to be assigned; you proactively identify system bottlenecks, mitigate risks, and build solutions. With extensive experience in high-scale API architecture, streaming data pipelines, and modern developer workflows (including AI-assisted debugging and pipeline optimizations), you possess the technical depth to debug complex integrations under pressure and the communication skills to interface effectively with both enterprise engineering teams and executive stakeholders. Responsibilities Serve as the single point of contact and DRI for technical partner success, from initial sandbox onboarding and go-live to production optimization. Maintain API reliability, performance, latency, uptime, and strict SLA compliance across all external data feeds and integrations. Establish proactive monitoring, logging, and automated alerting for data product health to resolve integration issues before they impact partners. Translate complex partner requirements and integration edge cases into actionable technical specifications and internal roadmap items. Partner with core engineering teams to harden APIs, optimize streaming pipelines, and refine data contracts based on production feedback. Maintain developer documentation, integration playbooks, architecture diagrams, and escalation paths. Qualifications 8+ years of software engineering experience, with a focus on partner engineering, solutions architecture, or external API integration. Deep technical expertise with REST/gRPC APIs, HTTP protocols, rate limiting, authentication frameworks (OAuth 2.0, API keys), and formal data contracts. Proven experience working directly with enterprise partners as the primary technical point of contact for complex integrations. Strong background in distributed systems, high-throughput event streaming (e.g., Kafka, Pub/Sub), and large-scale data delivery architectures. Demonstrated ability to debug complex, asynchronous systems under high pressure while communicating clear status updates to non-technical stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications Prior background in data monetization, adtech, or high-scale consumer internet platforms. descriptionText: Yahoo Mail is the ultimate consumer inbox with hundreds of millions of users. It’s the best way to access your email and stay organized from a computer, phone or tablet. title: Salesforce Solutions Architect
descriptionText: Hometown empowers schools with seamless digital tools for ticketing, fundraising, and event management, enabling them to create memorable in-person experiences that bring communities together. As a trusted partner dedicated to supporting athletics, arts, and extracurricular activities, we help schools generate vital funding to ensure every student has access to enriching opportunities. With a deep passion for serving those who shape our future, we make event operations effortless – so schools can focus on what truly matters: creating lasting impact in their hometowns. Job Description: Location: Remote Type: Full-time, independent contractor (long-term engagement) Hours: Full-time, with a minimum of 5 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern Time (9:00am–5:00pm ET core business hours) Who We Are: Hometown is the trusted leader in the education space, equipping athletic directors, coaches, and school administrators with the tools they need to manage their department communications, live events, and fundraisers. Hometown offers an all-in-one, easy-to-use platform to support schools in creating memorable in-person experiences and lasting impact in their communities. We’re continuing to expand our technology and team to provide the best-in-class service to organizations across the country! Hometown empowers all team members through a positive company culture. Exemplifying our core values of Hustle, Excellence, Resilience, and Ownership (HERO). We’re committed to providing a safe and inclusive work experience for everyone, both those working remotely and within our offices across the country. Consider joining our team today! Role Summary: We are looking for a Salesforce Solutions Architect to own our Salesforce instance end to end. You will be the technical owner of the platform that runs our go-to-market motion. You will be a part of our Business Operations team and report directly to our Senior Director of Operations. This is a hands-on ownership role, not an advisory one. You will inherit a mature, actively used org with automations, integrations, and reporting dependencies, and you will be responsible for keeping it healthy, making it better, and expanding it to support our multi-product go-to-market strategy across ticketing, fundraising, and websites and mobile apps. The person who succeeds here is someone who has done this at more than one company, can reverse-engineer an unfamiliar org, can receive business requirements directly from Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Finance, and can then design, build, test, and ship the change themselves. We are hiring for judgment and ownership as much as for build skill. You will be the person the business asks “can Salesforce do this?” and the person who decides the answer and implements it. Key Responsibilities: Ownership of the Salesforce instance: declarative configuration, permission sets and profiles, page layouts, record types, sharing rules, sandbox strategy, and release management. Maintain and stabilize: inherit the existing automation footprint (Flows, validation rules, assignment logic, approval processes), document what exists, retire what’s redundant, and eliminate the technical debt that accumulates in any fast-moving org. Improve and expand: identify friction in how our reps and CS team actually work, propose the fix, and ship it. Reduce clicks, improve data quality, and make the system reflect how the business actually sells. Build out our multi-product GTM in Salesforce: design the data model, opportunity architecture, product catalog, and pipeline structure required to sell, renew, and report on multiple products to the same school and district accounts. This includes cross-sell and upsell motion, product-level revenue reporting, bundling, and renewal architecture. Own the integrated stack: maintain and improve how Salesforce connects to Snowflake (our data warehouse), Gong (conversation intelligence and deal insight), and our other go-to-market and billing systems. Partner on data flows in both directions and ensure Salesforce remains the trusted source of truth for GTM data. Reporting and dashboards: build and maintain the reports, dashboards, and forecasting views that leadership, sales management, and Customer Success run on. Be opinionated about what “good” looks like. Gather requirements autonomously: run your own discovery with stakeholders across Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Finance, and leadership. Translate business problems into system design without requiring a project manager or business analyst in between. Governance and enablement: own user management and onboarding, data hygiene standards, field and object documentation, change control, and training for end users on what you build. Vendor and AppExchange management: evaluate, implement, and rationalize the third-party tools connected to the org. Preferred Education and Experience: 4–8 years of hands-on Salesforce experience, including primary ownership of at least one production org. Experience across multiple companies’ Salesforce instances. You’ve walked into orgs you didn’t build, figured out how they work, and improved them. We need someone who has done the inheriting before. Deep declarative expertise: Flow (record-triggered, screen, scheduled), validation rules, formula fields, dynamic forms, approval processes, permission set and sharing architecture, and complex data modeling. Comfortable reading, debugging, and reasoning about code. You can open Apex, triggers, and Lightning Web Components, understand what they do, identify when they’re the cause of a problem, and work with a developer or vendor to fix them. Reporting and data fluency: advanced Salesforce reporting, data loading and migration Integration experience. You’ve owned or heavily supported Salesforce integrations with a data warehouse, conversation intelligence tooling, marketing automation, or billing systems. Salesforce Administrator certification required; Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder, or Sales Cloud Consultant strongly preferred. Professional English fluency, written and verbal. You’ll be running requirements conversations directly with US-based stakeholders, including leadership. Demonstrated autonomy: a track record of operating as the only Salesforce person in the room, setting your own priorities against business goals, and driving change without being managed task to task. Nice To Have: Experience in B2B SaaS selling to schools, districts, higher education, or the public sector. Sandbox and deployment discipline: change sets, SFDX, Gearset, Copado, or similar. Experience with Salesforce AI features (Agentforce, Einstein) or Salesforce-connected AI tooling. Experience supporting a company through a product expansion, acquisition integration, or org consolidation. Experience architecting multi-product or multi-line-of-business selling in Salesforce (product catalog, CPQ or CPQ-adjacent quoting, bundling, product-level revenue reporting). Compensation: Fixed monthly amount of $5,000 USD Our compensation ranges are determined by a variety of factors, including role responsibilities, market data, and an individual's skills, experience, and qualifications. The final offer will be based on these factors and discussed throughout the interview process. Physical Requirements: Must be able to remain stationary for a long period of time, including working on a computer. This position may also be required to travel to client sites or conferences. This could include standing and walking for prolonged periods of time, and while outdoors in various weather conditions. Hometown values the importance of demonstrating to our customers that we care and are invested in our product and how it can be the best solution for them. All Hometown employees have a minimum amount of client events they must attend per year. This may include traveling to local client sites and could include standing and walking for prolonged periods of time, and while outdoors in various weather conditions.

AI tools, agents, and workflows are embedded into our delivery practices — accelerating discovery, documentation, analysis, backlog management, and team alignment. We are passionate, adaptive experts who continually practice and hone our craft. title: Staff Product Manager, Financial Systems
descriptionText: Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry’s digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity. Every dollar that moves through Xometry passes through Financial Systems: what a buyer is quoted and invoiced, what a partner is paid and when, what gets disputed, what gets recognized as revenue, and what finally lands in the ledger. As Staff Product Manager for Financial Systems, you will sit at the intersections of the order-to-cash and procure-to-pay lifecycles. You will collaborate with cross functional product teams making Xometry the most dependable marketplace for partners and customers. This is an individual contributor position that requires product manager proficiency and a deep understanding of financial and accounting operational functions and internal control concepts. You will be expected to read a journal entry, trace a transaction through to the general ledger, and understand why a control exists, or doesn’t, before you create a solution. Day to day, you will gather requirements from customers, partners, and our own Accounting team, and translate what you learn into products & features that serve all three. You will translate finance requirements into PRDs that engineers can design and build from. How You'll Contribute: Identify & Prioritize: Identify, define, and prioritize features & product enhancements that matter. You will communicate the value to the organization, and develop the metrics using data that supports the business case. Know the Personas: Develop a deep understanding of finance, procurement and operational persons and their end to end workflows from both the customer and internal accounting teams perspective so that requirements reflect how the work actually gets done from both the Procure to Pay and Order to Cash lenses. Cross Functional Alignment: Act as the hub between Engineering, Finance and Accounting, Sales, Order Operations, Partner Experience, Legal, and Tax, so that launches land with the field ready and users are informed. Own Release Enablement End to End: For every release, you own the communication, documentation, SOPs, and training, and coordinate with Marketing to inform customers and partners. Ensure that the work done turns a deployed feature into an adopted one. Build Controls into the Product: Partner with Accounting, Controllership, Tax, and Internal Audit so that segregation of duties, approval thresholds, the audit trail, revenue recognition treatment, and SOX-relevant controls are designed into workflows rather than reconciled around them afterward. Collaborate with other product managers to guide them through finance required specifications necessary for feature sign off and acceptance. Apply automation and AI where it is verifiable: Target the highest volume of manual work such as cash application, invoice exception handling, dispute triage, payout inquiries with automation that is measurable, reversible, and gated by human review where the cost of a silent error is high. Deconstruct Complex Problems: Break large, ambiguous problems into smaller pieces that deliver iterative wins, without losing sight of the outcome they add up to. Research & Auditing: You will work with accounts receivable and accounts payable teams and research/troubleshoot complex sales orders, purchase orders, general ledger postings and determine a course of action. What You'll Bring to Xometry: 8+ years of product, program or project management experience, and 4+ years in an accounting related role such as book keeping, staff accounting or audit. Accounting fundamentals are at the core of this position. Working fluency with accounting fundamentals, accrual concepts, revenue recognition, chart of accounts, reconciliation, month end close, audit and SOX controls sufficient to partner with Controllership and Accounting as peers rather than as requesters. Experience working with accounting software platforms (Sage Intacct, NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, or similar) that include the general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable or procurement subledgers, and how journal entries are recorded between ledgers; or homegrown systems that act as the subledger. Experience designing policy driven workflows (credit limits, approval routing, tiered sign-off, exception queues, escalation logic) rather than single user tools. Track record integrating with ERP platforms and third party solutions such as Stripe, Avalara, High Radius, Zuora, and eProcurment providers such as Coupa and Ariba. Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to distill financial and operational complexity into a clear narrative for engineers and executives alike. Proven ability to operate autonomously with a passion for problem solving and diving deep into transactional ecosystems to understand the micro details that are recorded in accounting systems. Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, or business, or 10+ years in an accounting related field; advanced degree (MBA,MS, MAcc) and ASC 606 a plus The estimated base salary range for new hires into this role is $180,000–$207,000 annually + bonus, depending on factors such as job-related skills, relevant experience, and location. We also offer a competitive benefits package, including 401(k) match, medical, dental, and vision insurance; life and disability insurance; generous paid time off including vacation, sick leave, floating and fixed holidays, maternity and bonding leave; an EAP; and other wellbeing resources. #LI-Hybrid Xometry is an

title: Migration Analyst
descriptionText: Who You’ll Work With As a Migration Consultant, you will help clients move trusted, usable data from legacy systems into new business applications. You will combine data analysis, mapping, transformation development, testing, and thoughtful collaboration to deliver migrations that support system adoption, business continuity, and measurable business outcomes. What You’ll Do Deliver Exceptional Solutions Analyze source data, source systems, business processes, and target-application requirements to identify data readiness, dependencies, quality issues, and migration risks. Translate business and technical requirements into clear source-to-target mappings, transformation rules, data-cleansing approaches, and traceable migration documentation. Develop and execute data extraction, transformation, and load activities using appropriate migration, ETL/ELT, SQL, scripting, and application tools. Support end-to-end migration cycles, including profiling, mock conversions, lower environment data loads, validation, reconciliation, defect resolution, cutover preparation, and post-go-live stabilization. Apply sound data-quality, security, privacy, and governance practices; escalate risks early and help the team resolve issues while maintaining delivery momentum. Communicate progress, findings, tradeoffs, and decisions clearly with project teams and client stakeholders, tailoring detail to the audience. Grow Your Expertise Build depth in enterprise application data models (e.g., Salesforce, ServiceNow, Anaplan, Dynamics, etc.), migration methods and patterns, and the industries, compliance regulations, and business processes served by our clients. Continuously improve technical and consulting skills, including practical use of automation and AI-enabled tools where they improve migration quality, efficiency, or insight. Document reusable mappings, test approaches, lessons learned, and delivery assets; share knowledge with teammates and contribute to migration accelerators. Seek feedback, learn from experienced practitioners, and coach junior team members through thoughtful review and day-to-day collaboration. Grow and Lead Slalom Build trusted, inclusive working relationships with clients and teammates; listen actively to understand underlying needs and respond constructively to feedback. Contribute migration insights, delivery observations, and client stories to account and project leaders to help identify follow-on opportunities. Represent Slalom’s values through accountable self-management, collaboration, and a commitment to high-quality client outcomes. What You’ll Bring 4+ years of experience in data and/or content migration, data conversion, data integration, data engineering, or a related technical consulting role; experience with enterprise application (e.g., Salesforce, ServiceNow, Anaplan, Dynamics, etc.) implementations is preferred. Hands-on experience analyzing data and developing migration components using SQL and one or more ETL/ELT, data integration, scripting, or migration tools (e.g., Capstorm, Data Loader, etc.). Working knowledge of data profiling, source-to-target mapping, transformation logic, data cleansing, validation, reconciliation, and issue management. Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into practical, well-documented data solutions. Familiarity with relational data models, APIs or file-based integrations, cloud platforms, and enterprise applications such as ERP, CRM, HCM, Finance, Supply Chain, or similar systems. Awareness of data governance, security, privacy, and compliance considerations in handling business data. Strong analytical, problem-solving, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical findings clearly to both technical and business audiences. A collaborative, curious, and growth-oriented mindset; ability to manage competing priorities, work through ambiguity with appropriate guidance, and take ownership of commitments. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Willingness to travel up to 50% based on client and project needs. What Success Looks Like Migration work products are accurate, traceable, and completed on time, enabling reliable testing, cutover readiness, and a smooth data/content transition to the new application. Data issues, dependencies, and risks are identified early, communicated clearly, and resolved or escalated with practical recommendations. Clients and teammates rely on you for organized analysis, dependable development, constructive collaboration, and candid communication about progress and tradeoffs. Validation and reconciliation results demonstrate that migrated data or content meets agreed quality, completeness, and business-use requirements. You become increasingly effective across migration tools, data domains, and client contexts, and share lessons and reusable assets that improve the team’s delivery capability. You contribute to a positive, inclusive team environment and help create opportunities for Slalom through excellent delivery and trusted client relationships. title: Senior Manager, Renewals
descriptionText: 1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing. About 1Password At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work. If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future. The Renewals team protects and grows 1Password's recurring revenue by helping customers realize ongoing value and make confident decisions about their subscriptions. As Senior Manager, Renewals, you'll lead the global renewals function, owning the operating model, team performance, and renewal outcomes that support retention and expansion. You'll lead renewal managers across regions, establish the standards and systems that make the renewal motion predictable, and partner with senior leaders across Go To Market (GTM) to resolve risk and capture growth opportunities. This role reports to the Senior Director, Customer Success. How we’re using AI today Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here. This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US. Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto. What we're looking for: • Lead renewals, customer success, account management, or a related post-sale function in Business-to-Business (B2B) SaaS, with a demonstrated record of owning retention outcomes. • Manage global or senior renewals teams, including hiring, developing, and supporting managers or team leads. • Lead complex renewal negotiations with enterprise customers while building repeatable renewal motions for smaller customer segments. • Apply strong knowledge of renewal frameworks, commercial terms, pricing, procurement, legal processes, forecasting, and retention metrics such as gross retention rate, net retention rate, churn, renewal rate, and expansion. • Use Salesforce, Gainsight, or comparable customer success platforms to manage customer health, risk, forecasts, and team performance. • Build trusted partnerships across Customer Success, Sales, Revenue Operations (RevOps), Finance, Legal, Support, Solutions Engineering, and Product. • Bring experience in cybersecurity, identity security, or identity and access management; experience as a 1Password user or practitioner is a plus. What you can expect: • Lead, develop, and scale a high-performing renewals team across regions and experience levels. • Own the global renewals forecast and retention outcomes, partnering with Customer Success and Sales on expansion opportunities. • Establish clear standards for coverage, handoffs, risk management, negotiation, forecasting, and performance management. • Coach managers and team members through deal reviews, call debriefs, calibration, and development plans. • Partner with senior leaders to resolve complex renewal situations and embed learnings into the broader operating model. • Design and improve renewal playbooks, commercial workflows, AI-assisted systems, and enablement programs that increase team capacity and create repeatable outcomes. • Provide clear, commercially disciplined insight into renewal performance, risk, expansion opportunities, and strategic priorities. USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $139,000 USD and $202,000 USD, and is commission-eligible. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs. Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $137,000 CAD and $199,000 CAD, and is commission-eligible. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs. At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set. This posting is for an existing vacancy. Our culture At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first. title: Client Success Manager
descriptionText: We exist for workers and their employers -- who are the backbone of our economy. That is where Centivo comes in -- our mission is to bring affordable, high-quality healthcare to the millions who struggle to pay their healthcare bills. Summary of Role The Client Success Manager (CSM) provides the day-to-day operational support that keeps Centivo's client experience running smoothly. This is an intermediate, client-facing role: the CSM attends and supports client meetings and open enrollment sessions, supporting the Client Success Executive (CSE) who leads the relationship. The CSM partners closely with the CSE to execute the operational work behind renewals, escalations, and ongoing plan administration — resolving claims, benefit, and enrollment issues; coordinating across internal teams and external vendors; and keeping client-facing systems, workbooks, and communications accurate and current. On a smaller book of business, and at leadership discretion, a CSM may hold light day-to-day ownership of a client relationship. Responsibilities Include Client Service & Issue Resolution - Apply a developed understanding of Centivo's operational functions to support and perform to established service standards for renewals and client service. - Provide ongoing service and support to the Client Success Executive, partnering across internal and external departments and vendors to resolve claims, benefit, and enrollment issues. - Record and monitor all inquiries through completion and maintaining the client tracker for each client in their book, keeping the Client Success Executive apprised of status. - Handle client inquiries and collaborate with claims and member care to resolve them. - Support tracking and follow-up on member issues, including VIP member issues, in partnership with the Customer Issue Resolutions Team; the Client Success Executive leads remediation strategy on complex or sensitive escalations. - Enter SRS tickets for Cigna issues and track them through to resolution. - Elevate client inquiries and concerns to the Client Success Executive and/or the Client Escalations team as appropriate. - Review HCC notices for accuracy & to ensure they are at the appropriate threshold prior to Client Ops sending them out Client Administration & Project Coordination - Execute follow-ups on open items and tasks, including cross-functional tasks related to issue resolution and benefit plan changes; escalate non-movement on open items as appropriate. - Provide operational support and coordination on client projects, including renewals and terminations. - Set up and maintain access for reporting tools & employer portals. - Updating Salesforce when client or broker contact information changes. Open Enrollment (OE) & Renewal Support - Attend and support open enrollment meetings (virtual and in-person) as needed; the Client Success Executive leads OE strategy, content, and client messaging. - Support initial Middle Market OE communications and member portal testing. - Prepare the renewal confirmation form in conjunction with the Client Success Executive. - Review SBCs, SPDs and amendments for accuracy prior to sending to the client. Systems & Data Management - Enter client-specific information from the MCW into Salesforce, including flagging clients and brokers for marketing blasts and adding applicable details such as check run date, eligibility method, and high-dollar information. - Maintain the Master Client Workbook and benefit summaries post go-live. - Send Zakipoint data as required. - Support reporting ticket requests, run ad hoc reports as appropriate, and provide real-time tracking, live updates, and follow-up; the Client Success Executive reviews reporting before release to ensure alignment with strategic renewal discussions. Additional Reporting Support - Prepare client-related reporting and various internal reports in accordance with each client's specific requirements, along with responding to inquiries from internal departments. - Run claims impact reports. - Review initial renewing invoices. - Review plan documents and ID cards for accuracy at renewal. Qualifications Required Skills and Abilities - Bachelor's degree preferred, or equivalent combination of education and experience. - 3 years of experience in client service, account management, or operations, within health benefits, insurance, or a related industry (such as PBM); this is an intermediate, client-facing role rather than an entry-level position. - Strong working knowledge of health plan operations, including claims, benefits, and enrollment processes. - Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, track detailed work through to completion, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment. - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally with clients, brokers, and internal teams, and to represent operational details clearly in meetings led by others. - Comfort working across systems (e.g., Salesforce, Plan Manager) and maintaining data accuracy across multiple sources. - Collaborative mindset with the ability to coordinate effectively across internal departments and external vendors, and to work in close partnership with a Client Success Executive. - High attention to detail and strong organizational skills. - Willingness to travel on a minimal-to-moderate basis for open enrollment and client support needs. Work Location - An ideal candidate would be assigned to the Buffalo office with the ability to work from home. - This position is remote. Who we are: Centivo is an innovative health plan for self-funded employers on a mission to bring affordable, high-quality healthcare to the millions who struggle to pay their healthcare bills. Anchored around a primary care based ACO model, Centivo saves employers 15 to 30 percent compared to traditional insurance carriers. Employees also realize significant savings through our free primary care (including virtual), predictable copay and no-deductible benefit plan design. Centivo works with employers ranging in size from 51 employees to Fortune 500 companies. For more information, visit centivo.com http://centivo.com. Headquartered in Buffalo, NY with offices in New York City and Buffalo, Centivo is backed by leading healthcare and technology investors, including a recent round of investment from Morgan Health, a business unit of JPMorgan Chase & Co.

track CAPAs to timely closure and verify effectiveness. - Maintain accurate, audit-ready documentation in line with Good Documentation Practice (GDP), including complaint files, correspondence with patients/prescribers/suppliers, and trending data. - Identify and report trends in complaint data to the Superintendent Pharmacist and Quality leadership, flagging recurring issues that may indicate a systemic quality or supply issue. - Support the Superintendent Pharmacist in maintaining the pharmacy's compliance with MHRA inspection readiness, GPhC standards for registered pharmacies, and relevant SOPs governing complaint handling, deviations, and non-conformances. - Assist with drafting, reviewing, and revising SOPs related to complaint handling, non-conformance management, and supplier quality as it relates to complaint handling for both the dispensing and compounding operations. - Liaise with pharmaceutical suppliers and wholesalers to ensure appropriate records are available as necessary to close out applicable complaint investigations, when necessary. - Support internal audits and MHRA/GPhC inspections by preparing complaint files, trend reports, and CAPA evidence. - Escalate any signal of a potential quality defect, adverse reaction, or patient safety risk to the Superintendent Pharmacist without delay. Résumé du poste L’ Analyste du transport est responsable de la gestion de bout en bout, de l’optimisation et de la gouvernance des activités de transport qui soutiennent la division Solutions technologiques de McKesson. La personne titulaire du poste agit à titre d’experte en matière pour le transport au sein de l’organisation et assume la responsabilité du transport entrant et sortant, des installations, des relocalisations, de la logistique des salons professionnels, de la conformité douanière, de la gestion des transporteurs, de l’optimisation du fret, de l’exécution de la stratégie de transport et du rendement budgétaire du transport. En collaboration avec l’Analyste associé senior du transport, la personne titulaire du poste gère de façon autonome les activités de transport, élabore et tient à jour les normes de transport, mène des initiatives d’amélioration continue et collabore avec les parties prenantes internes ainsi qu’avec les partenaires logistiques externes afin d’assurer des services de transport rentables, conformes, évolutifs et de grande qualité. Veiller à ce que les expéditions respectent les exigences en matière de service à la clientèle, de qualité, de réglementation et de livraison. Surveiller les délais de transport et intervenir de façon proactive en cas de risque ou de perturbation du service. Coordonner les exigences logistiques liées aux installations chez les clients, aux déménagements de bureaux, aux déploiements d’équipement et aux projets spéciaux. title: Director, Product Management, Search Monetization
descriptionText: Yahoo serves as a trusted guide for hundreds of millions of people globally, helping them achieve their goals online through our portfolio of iconic products. For advertisers, Yahoo Advertising offers omnichannel solutions and powerful data to engage with our brands and deliver results. Director, Product Management, Search Monetization A Little About Us Yahoo Search helps millions of people find information, answers, products, services, and inspiration across the web. The Search Product team is building the next generation of Yahoo Search, evolving both our traditional search results experience and new AI-powered experiences such as Scout. Monetization is a critical part of that future. Our team is responsible for creating advertising experiences that deliver strong value for users, advertisers, and Yahoo. We work at the intersection of consumer experience, advertising technology, machine learning, data science, and business strategy, with an opportunity to both optimize a scaled existing business and define entirely new monetization models for AI-powered search. About the Role We are seeking a Director of Product Management, Search Monetization to own product strategy and execution for monetization across Yahoo Search. This is a senior individual contributor role for a hands-on product leader with deep experience in sponsored search and search advertising. You will be responsible for improving the performance of advertising across our search results pages while protecting and improving the overall user experience. You will also help define the future of monetization for AI-powered Search, including Scout, developing new ad products and commercial experiences that feel native to how people discover information and make decisions in conversational and generative experiences. This role combines optimization and invention. You will work deeply on ad relevance, ranking, placement, density, query coverage, marketplace dynamics, and experimentation, while also identifying and developing entirely new advertising concepts and business models. You will partner closely with Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Design, Research, Business Development, Finance, and other Product teams. Because Yahoo works with external advertising marketplaces and technology partners, you will also play an important role in defining product requirements, identifying opportunities, and working across partner ecosystems to improve monetization outcomes. We are looking for someone who can move comfortably between strategy and execution: defining where Search monetization should go, digging into performance data to understand why RPM moved, working with engineers and data scientists on optimization opportunities, and developing new ideas for how advertising can create value in the next generation of Search. Responsibilities Own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and execution for monetization across Yahoo Search, spanning traditional search results pages and emerging AI-powered Search experiences. Drive meaningful improvements in Search revenue and RPM while maintaining clear user experience guardrails and high standards for ad quality and relevance. Optimize sponsored search across ad relevance, ranking, placement, density, presentation, query coverage, and other product and marketplace levers, including expanding monetizable query coverage where appropriate. Define and build a scalable monetization model for Scout and other AI-powered Search experiences, inventing, prototyping, testing, and scaling new advertising formats and commercial experiences for generative, conversational, and agentic interactions. Modernize Yahoo Search's approach to ad optimization, partnering with Engineering and Data Science on ranking systems, machine learning models, decisioning systems, experimentation capabilities, and supporting platform investments. Develop a deep understanding of Search monetization performance, using statistical analysis, experimentation, marketplace data, and user behavior to diagnose opportunities and prioritize investments. Design and interpret experiments in complex advertising marketplace environments, including situations where traditional experimentation is constrained by marketplace dynamics, partner systems, auction effects, or limited traffic. Establish success metrics and measurement frameworks that balance revenue, RPM, advertiser value, ad relevance, engagement, query coverage, and user experience. Partner closely with external advertising and technology partners, as well as Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, and Design, to identify opportunities, define requirements, troubleshoot performance, launch new experiences, and move products from concept through scaled launch. Develop a strong understanding of advertiser needs, marketplace dynamics, competitive trends, and emerging advertising models, translating those insights into new product opportunities and clearly communicating strategy, performance, and tradeoffs to senior leaders. Minimum Qualifications 9+ years of Product Management or equivalent experience, including significant experience building and optimizing advertising or monetization products at scale. 5+ years of direct experience with search advertising, sponsored search, or closely related performance advertising products, with a strong understanding of search intent, ad relevance, advertiser value, and user experience. Demonstrated success improving scaled advertising or monetization products through optimization, experimentation, and data-driven decision making, with strong knowledge of ad ranking, relevance, placement, coverage, yield, and marketplace dynamics. Experience working with programmatic advertising marketplaces, external ad platforms, advertising partners, or similar multi-party ecosystems. Strong analytical and quantitative skills, including experience interpreting statistical analyses, marketplace data, large-scale product metrics, and experiments in environments where traditional A/B testing may have limitations. Technical fluency sufficient to work deeply with engineers and data scientists on machine learning models, ranking and decisioning systems, experimentation frameworks, data pipelines, and system architecture. Strong product judgment and user empathy, with demonstrated ability to balance monetization and consumer experience while translating ambiguous commercial opportunities into product concepts, hypotheses, experiments, and roadmaps. Ability to operate as a highly autonomous, hands-on senior individual contributor, moving fluidly between strategy and detailed execution and communicating complex product, technical, and business tradeoffs to senior leaders and cross-functional partners. Preferred Qualifications Experience owning monetization for a large-scale consumer search, commerce, marketplace, or discovery product. Experience building or optimizing advertising products powered by machine learning, relevance models, recommendation systems, auction systems, or marketplace technology. Experience developing new advertising formats or monetization models, including for AI-powered, conversational, generative, recommendation, or agentic consumer experiences. Experience working across multiple external advertising or technology partners where product performance depends on systems outside your direct ownership. Familiarity with advertiser economics, auction dynamics, conversion measurement, attribution, and other components of the advertising ecosystem. A track record of identifying non-obvious monetization opportunities and turning them into products that create meaningful value for users, advertisers, and the business, including using AI-assisted tools for analysis, ideation, prototyping, or product discovery. The material job duties and responsibilities of this role include those listed above as well as adhering to Yahoo policies; exercising sound judgment; working effectively, safely and inclusively with others; exhibiting trustworthiness and meeting expectations; and safeguarding business operations and brand integrity. descriptionText: Huron helps its clients drive growth, enhance performance and sustain leadership in the markets they serve. Investing in new partnerships, clinical services and technology is not enough to create meaningful and substantive change. To succeed long-term, healthcare organizations must empower leaders, clinicians, employees, affiliates and communities to build cultures that foster innovation to achieve the best outcomes for patients. Joining the Huron team means you’ll help our clients evolve and adapt to the rapidly changing healthcare environment and optimize existing business operations, improve clinical outcomes, create a more consumer-centric healthcare experience, and drive physician, patient and employee engagement across the enterprise. Join our team as the expert you are now and create your future. We are looking for a Platform Integration Engineer to join our engineering team and take on one of our most strategically important challenges: unifying a diverse ecosystem of analytics applications under a coherent, scalable technology platform. Our analytics landscape has grown organically across multiple teams and products. The result is a collection of powerful but siloed tools — each with its own technology stack, data contracts, and deployment patterns. You will be the connective tissue that brings these applications together, making pragmatic decisions about when to consolidate and when to preserve the right tool for the right job. This role is for an engineer who is energized by ambiguity, skilled at reading distributed systems, and opinionated (but flexible) about platform design. You will work directly with engineering leads and data teams, and you will be empowered to use AI-assisted development tools as a first-class part of your workflow. What You’ll Do Platform Unification & Integration Audit existing analytics applications to understand their underlying technology choices, data flows, and integration points Design and implement integration patterns (APIs, event streams, shared data contracts) that allow siloed applications to interoperate without unnecessary rewrites Evaluate build vs. consolidate vs. federate tradeoffs for components across the platform, documenting your rationale and driving alignment Build and maintain shared platform services — authentication, observability, configuration management, logging — that reduce duplication across applications Data Pipeline & ETL Engineering Develop a deep understanding of existing data pipelines owned by distributed teams — including their data sources, transformation logic, and dependencies Design and build a unified presentation layer that surfaces data from heterogeneous compute environments — including large-scale distributed systems (e.g., Spark) and traditional relational databases — in a consistent, accessible way Partner with domain teams who have the deepest knowledge of their own data — acting as an integration architect and collaborator rather than a centralized pipeline owner; identify unification opportunities but defer to domain expertise on data semantics and processing logic Cloud Infrastructure Deploy and manage platform services on cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred; Azure/GCP experience a plus) Contribute to infrastructure-as-code practices using tools such as Terraform, CDK, or Pulumi Collaborate with DevOps/SRE to define deployment pipelines and reliability standards for integration services Construct evidence-based business cases for cloud feature adoption — translating technical requirements into business value, risk reduction, and compliance language that resonates with IT governance and procurement stakeholders What We’re Looking For Required Qualifications 3+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 1 years focused on integration, platform, or infrastructure work Proficiency in at least one backend language commonly used in data-intensive systems (Python, Go, Java, or similar); proficiency in two or more languages strongly preferred Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS strongly preferred) including compute, storage, networking, and managed services Experience building and operating data pipelines (ETL/ELT), including schema management and data quality monitoring Working experience with AI-assisted development tooling in a professional engineering context Strong written communication skills — able to produce clear architecture decision records (ADRs), runbooks, and design documents Preferred Qualifications Experience evaluating and rationalizing heterogeneous technology stacks — i.e., inheriting systems you didn’t design and making them work together Familiarity with analytics or ML platform tooling (e.g., Airflow, dbt, MLflow, Spark, or SaaS equivalents) Experience with API gateway management, service mesh, or distributed tracing tooling Background working with both structured (SQL) and semi-structured (JSON, Parquet, Avro) data at scale How You Work We care as much about how you think as what you’ve built.
